'''Deoan''' is a man from [[Deven Ride]].

==Activities==
During the [[Last Battle]], [[Tam al'Thor]] has Deoan lead half the Two Rivers men in an attack against the [[Trolloc]]s.{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Deoan is named after Travis Hall, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. His screen name was Deoan Kakarot.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
